mapper.sql: entity, subject_id, lookup, attempts, last_tried, next_try, found
mapper.select: SELECT FROM link_attempt WHERE entity = #{entity}::char(1) AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND lookup = #{lookup}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO link_attempt (entity, subject_id, lookup, attempts, last_tried, next_try, found) VALUES (#{entity}::char(1), #{subjectId}, #{lookup}, 1, now(), #{nextTry}, #{found}) ON CONFLICT (entity, subject_id, lookup) DO UPDATE SET attempts = link_attempt.attempts + 1, last_tried = now(), next_try = EXCLUDED.next_try, found = EXCLUDED.found
mapper.update: UPDATE link_attempt SET next_try = NULL WHERE entity = #{entity}::char(1) AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND lookup = #{lookup}

choose.when: UPDATE link_attempt SET next_try = NULL WHERE entity = #{entity}::char(1) AND next_try IS NOT NULL AND subject_id IN #{i}
choose.otherwise: UPDATE link_attempt SET next_try = NULL WHERE false
